title: Salzburg Walking Tour: Mozart’s Birthplace and Mirabell Gardens
creator: Conor Mac
description: A walk from the Mirabell Gardens across the Salzach river into the old town, past the cathedral and the squares, ending at Mozart’s birthplace on Getreidegasse.

title: Salzburg Is Alive with the Sound of Trudy’s Music
creator: Alex
description: A walk through the old town’s Sound of Music locations, from the fountain on Residenzplatz that Maria splashes in to Nonnberg Abbey, with the real von Trapp story along the way.
